assets.note: No music (the user's standing rule: code-synthesized effects, no background music in documentaries). The effects track (sea, wind, storm and thunder, the stone hall, under the water, oars, armies at war, the bull, orichalcum's gleam, the earthquake and flood, Thera's eruption, Helike's wave, ripples) is synthesized from code by sfx/make_sound.py in this project from js/cues.js — no recorded or downloaded sound — and wrapped with a 16x16 black picture by ffmpeg so js/media.js can play it on the master clock.
